messages:
Irene M.: noticed discrepancy in today's billing reconciliation: 5 Stripe charges exist but no invoices in NetSuite. stripe says webhooks delivered 200. :thinking:
Daniel P.: can you paste the webhook handler logs for that window? we had a queue outage last week.
Irene M.: logs attached: handler verifies signature, then returns 200 immediately, then `enqueue` fails with `kafka: unknown partition` error. so we acked before persisting.
Ravi S.: that pattern rings a bell. previous patch changed the handler to be non-blocking for throughput. bad call if queue is flaky.
Irene M.: timestamps: 2026-04-20T09:47:12Z through 09:49:02Z, 5 events.
StripeBot: stripe deliver logs: event delivery success (status 200) for evt_3Lxxx (5 events) link: https://dashboard.stripe.com/events
Daniel P.: short-term: re-enqueue events by replaying them from Stripe dashboard once we fix the handler to only 200 after enqueue. also add a tombstone DB write to mark event received before enqueue so replays are idempotent.
Ravi S.: long-term: switch to durable buffer (Kafka with replication) and add healthcheck gating on webhook pods so they return 500 if producer not healthy. also add alert when webhook_enqueue_errors > 0.
NetSuiteAdmin: from NS side, we didn't receive any create calls for those payments. happy to accept replays.
Irene M.: I've started a reconcile job to match stripe payments vs ns invoices and will requeue missing ones after hotfix deploy.
Daniel P.: will open PR to make handler synchronous (respond 200 only after enqueue success) and add metric + tombstone write. target: staging in 1h.
Ravi S.: also pls add unique constraint on stripe_event_id in billing_events table to avoid dupes on replay.
Irene M.: assigning: Daniel -> webhook hotfix + PR, Ravi -> infra durable queue plan, Irene -> reconciliation and replay.
Daniel P.: PR 4388 created. testing on staging now.
Irene M.: replay to staging shows invoices created. will schedule prod replay once PR is canaried.
StripeBot: replay available for 5 events.
Irene M.: thanks all. closing thread once prod replay completes and finance confirms numbers match. :white_check_mark:
